# ---- more boundaries ----
def hdr2(kmatch=True, q=3, t=5):
    b = bytearray.fromhex('aabbcc77ee000000')
    if not kmatch: b[0] = 0x01
    b[5] = q; b[6] = t
    return b.hex()

# float-integer acceptance (design choice: integral floats are integers)
check('float-count', run([json.dumps(dict(mode='plan', capacities={'a':3,'b':3,'r':3}, flows=[F], warmup=0.0, pinned=[],
      offers={'f': [dict(header=hdr2(), count=1.0)]}))])[0], {'selected': ['f'], 'saved': 9})
check('float-nonintegral', run([json.dumps(dict(mode='plan', capacities={'a':3,'b':3,'r':3}, flows=[F], warmup=0.5, pinned=[],
      offers={'f': [dict(header=hdr2(), count=1)]}))])[0], {'error': 'input'})
check('bool-count', run([json.dumps(dict(mode='plan', capacities={'a':3,'b':3,'r':3}, flows=[F], warmup=0, pinned=[],
      offers={'f': [dict(header=hdr2(), count=True)]}))])[0], {'error': 'input'})
check('exp-notation', run(['{"mode":"plan","capacities":{"a":3,"b":3,"r":3},"flows":[{"id":"f","path":["a","b","r"],"template":"aabbcc0000000000","kinds":"KKKDZQTK"}],"warmup":1e1,"pinned":[],"offers":{"f":[{"header":"aabbcc77ee030500","count":1}]}}'])[0], {'selected': [], 'saved': 0})

# 2049-byte payload -> error
pay2049 = 'aa' * 2049
check('payload-2049', run([json.dumps(dict(mode='replay', capacities={'a':3,'b':3,'r':3}, flows=[fm],
      events=[dict(op='packet',flow='f',header='aabbcc77ee030900',payload=pay2049)]))])[0], {'error': 'input'})
check('payload-2048', run([json.dumps(dict(mode='replay', capacities={'a':3,'b':3,'r':3}, flows=[fm],
      events=[dict(op='packet',flow='f',header='aabbcc77ee030900',payload='aa'*2048)]))])[0]['results'][0]['mode'], 'mpls')

# 20001 events -> error
ev = [dict(op='reset')] * 20001
check('events-20001', run([json.dumps(dict(mode='replay', capacities={'a':3}, flows=[], events=ev))])[0], {'error': 'input'})
ev = [dict(op='reset')] * 20000
check('events-20000', run([json.dumps(dict(mode='replay', capacities={'a':3}, flows=[], events=ev))])[0]['results'][-1], {'status': 'ok'})

# path length 10 -> error ; 9 -> ok
p10 = ['n%d'%i for i in range(10)]
check('path-10', run([json.dumps(dict(mode='replay', capacities={n:1 for n in p10},
      flows=[dict(id='f',path=p10,labels=[16]*10,template='aabbcc0000000000',kinds='KKKDZQTK')], events=[]))])[0], {'error': 'input'})
p9 = ['n%d'%i for i in range(9)]
check('path-9', run([json.dumps(dict(mode='replay', capacities={n:1 for n in p9},
      flows=[dict(id='f',path=p9,labels=[16]*9,template='aabbcc0000000000',kinds='KKKDZQTK')], events=[]))])[0], {'results': [], 'active': [], 'tables': []})

# H=257 -> error ; H=256 ok
t257 = 'aa'*257
check('H-257', run([json.dumps(dict(mode='replay', capacities={'a':3},
      flows=[dict(id='f',path=['a','b','c'],labels=[16,17,18],template=t257,kinds='K'*255+'QT')], events=[]))])[0], {'error': 'input'})

# label boundaries: 15 -> error, 16 ok, 1048575 ok, 1048576 -> error
for lab, ok in [(15, False), (16, True), (1048575, True), (1048576, False)]:
    g = run([json.dumps(dict(mode='replay', capacities={'a':3},
          flows=[dict(id='f',path=['a','b','c'],labels=[lab,17,18],template='aabbcc0000000000',kinds='KKKDZQTK')], events=[]))])[0]
    exp = {'results': [], 'active': [], 'tables': []} if ok else {'error': 'input'}
    check(f'label-{lab}', g, exp)

# capacity boundary 512 ok / 513 err already covered; warmup boundary 1e9 ok / 1e9+1 err
check('warmup-1e9-ok', run([json.dumps(dict(mode='plan', capacities={'a':3}, flows=[], warmup=10**9, pinned=[], offers={}))])[0], {'selected': [], 'saved': 0})
check('warmup-1e9+1', run([json.dumps(dict(mode='plan', capacities={'a':3}, flows=[], warmup=10**9+1, pinned=[], offers={}))])[0], {'error': 'input'})

# run count boundaries: 1e9 ok (total per flow), 256 runs ok, 257 err
runs257 = [dict(header=hdr2(), count=1) for _ in range(257)]
check('runs-257', run([json.dumps(dict(mode='plan', capacities={'a':3,'b':3,'r':3}, flows=[F], warmup=0, pinned=[], offers={'f': runs257}))])[0], {'error': 'input'})
runs256 = [dict(header=hdr2(), count=1) for _ in range(256)]
check('runs-256', run([json.dumps(dict(mode='plan', capacities={'a':3,'b':3,'r':3}, flows=[F], warmup=0, pinned=[], offers={'f': runs256}))])[0], {'selected': ['f'], 'saved': 256*9})

# run header byte budget: 65536 total bytes across runs -> ok / 65537 -> err
# each run header is 8 bytes; 8192 runs would exceed 256/runs-per-flow limit; use 4 flows x 256 runs x 8B = 8192... need 65536: use H=256 flows
bigK = 'K' + 'D'*0 + 'Z'*253 + 'QT'  # H=256? len = 1+253+2 = 256 ok; D=0
FB2 = dict(id='bb', path=['a','b','r'], template=('cd'*256), kinds=bigK)
runs = [dict(header=('cd'*255 + '0305'), count=1) for _ in range(256)]
# 256 runs * 256 bytes = 65536 exactly -> ok
check('runbytes-65536', run([json.dumps(dict(mode='plan', capacities={'a':3,'b':3,'r':3}, flows=[FB2], warmup=0, pinned=[], offers={'bb': runs}))])[0].get('saved', 'err'), 256*(256-4-0)*3)
